correctness.rationale: For n>1, phi(psi(n))/n=P(n)R(n). Bounding P by small-prime products rules out odd supports and all even supports of size <=5. For six supports, any factor >=5 in psi forces R<=4/15 while P<=2304/715<15/4, so psi support is exactly {2,3}; then P>3 forces 2,3,5,7 and two primes u<v with 2,3-smooth successors. Exact product bounds restrict u to 11 or17, v<384 for u11 and v<576/19 for u17, yielding exactly 10+1 prime pairs; exponents >=5 must be one, a,b>=1 arbitrary. Checked rational ratios include q383 147456/147455 and 17,23 13824/13685; catalog eleven rows were inspected and the prime bound exhausts all cases.
residual_risks: A direct sweep up to 400000 is corroboration only; the unbounded claim relies on the analytic support bounds and complete finite list below 384.
